identity.name: r1o-et
identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only mergekit recipe and base components, with no reported evaluations or training-data details for this exact checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card names the merged source models but does not document their training datasets or any synthetic data generation details.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: The checkpoint is a merge of pre-trained models; the underlying training data is not accessible from the card, limiting explanation of outputs.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Because the training data of the merged components is not accessible, content provenance for generated outputs cannot be traced.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states only that it is a text-to-text model merge, with no intended-use or misuse definition.

specifications.model_size: 14.2 GiB of safetensors weights (15,225,652,144 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a merge created with mergekit, using the Linear DARE merge method with marcuscedricridia/cursa-o1-7b as the base.
training_context.training_data: The target checkpoint is a merge of pre-trained language models; the merge included huihui-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B-abliterated-v2 and suayptalha/Clarus-7B-v0.2.
